headline: Source: Texans' Nico Collins (hamstring) uncertain for Week 2
summary: Texans star wide receiver Nico Collins suffered a hamstring injury during Wednesday's practice and is uncertain to play in Week 2 against the Bengals, a source told ESPN.

headline: Brian Belichick takes over Steve Belichick's role calling defense for Bill Belichick's team
summary: With one of Bill Belichick's sons resigning as his defensive coordinator, Belichick's other son will take on the role.

headline: Seahawks Rule Out QB Sam Darnold For Week 2
summary: As expected, the Seahawks will be without their starting quarterback in Week 2. Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed on Wednesday that Sam Darnold will miss Seattle’s upcoming game against the Cardinals. headline: How family and fatherhood are fueling Lions QB Jared Goff
summary: The arrival of Goff's daughter, Romy Isabelle, has helped sharpened the quarterback's focus heading into 2026.

headline: Browns-Buccaneers matchup Sunday is more than just Baker Mayfield facing his old team
summary: — Baker Mayfield has become the leader and face of the franchise the Cleveland Browns hoped for when they drafted him No. 1 overall in 2018.
